definitions.gloss: cave; cavern; hole in a rock; rocky hollow
definitions.explanation: A natural cavity or hole formed in rock. Can range from a small hollow to a sizable cave.

examples.japanese: {岩穴|いわあな}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{涼|すず}しかった→涼しい：00674_suzushii⟧。
examples.english: Inside the cave it was cool.

examples.japanese: ⟦{崖|がけ}→崖：05391_gake⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{途中|とちゅう}→途中：01684_tochuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{小|ちい}さな→小さな：02913_chiisana⟧{岩穴|いわあな}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あり→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦{鳥|とり}→鳥：00679_tori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{巣|す}→巣：02140_su⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}っていた→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: There was a small rock cavity partway up the cliff, where birds had made a nest.

notes:
A straightforward compound of ⟦{岩|いわ}→岩：00850_iwa⟧ (rock) + ⟦{穴|あな}→穴：01691_ana⟧ (hole). Has a more natural, literary feel compared to the scientific term ⟦{洞窟|どうくつ}→洞窟：05038_doukutsu⟧. Often appears in folklore, mythology, and nature writing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {岩穴|いわあな}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}む→住む：00673_sumu⟧: to live in a cave
- {岩穴|いわあな}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{隠|かく}れる→隠れる：02035_kakureru⟧: to hide in a cave

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{洞窟|どうくつ}→洞窟：05038_doukutsu⟧: cave, cavern (the standard, more formal/scientific term)
- {洞穴|どうけつ}/⟦{洞穴|ほらあな}→洞穴：16206_horaana⟧: cave, grotto
- ⟦{鍾乳洞|しょうにゅうどう}→鍾乳洞：18923_shounyuudou⟧: limestone cave, stalactite cave
